assertions.assert: Without memory (`database` `null`), a stimulus no seed triggers runs nothing: it ends with donedata `{turn, handled: false, candidates: [], reason: "no-behaviors"}`. Its donedata is its only answer: it sends its parent no event.

A `bot.ability.listening.speech.output` stimulus runs the SpeechHeard seed first, with the <param>s turn, input and stimulus. Speech with a source is handled: it ends with `{turn, handled: true, selected, candidates: ["SpeechHeard"], reason: "behavior"}`, `selected` the seed's one `bot.ability.communication.input` selection (the speech's `source_ids`, empty `target_ids`, `content`, `content_type`, `sample_rate_hz`, `channels`), trusted and naming no target (the body sends it to itself).
A seed that does not handle the turn passes it to the learned inventory; without memory the turn is unhandled: `{turn, handled: false, candidates: ["SpeechHeard"], reason: "unhandled"}`.

With memory, one transaction of the Memory ability on the `database` <param> loads the ACTIVE `turn` behaviors whose trigger is the stimulus's event; when none matches, the turn is `no-behaviors`, or `unhandled` with the seed in `candidates` when a seed ran.
A load that fails or outlasts `memory_timeout_ms` matches no behaviors and the turn goes on, as a load with no rows does.

A `bot.perceived` stimulus (the body's percepts taken together) is matched percept by percept, in arrival order, each percept's stimulus as the stimulus: the turn is handled only when every percept was, `selected` the handling behaviors' selections in arrival order; otherwise it is `unhandled` (or `no-behaviors` when nothing was tried), and `acted` `{percepts, acts}` (the reference's ActedData) names the handled percepts' positions and their selections when any was.
